comparison.objective: Get a stalled gear train turning; cause and detailed rubric are absent.
comparison.physical_skill: Diagnose and relieve a rotational mechanism jam or apply appropriate drive torque, not align a break-off mandrel and deliver controlled impacts.
comparison.success_condition: Gear train resumes rotation; speed, duration, damage and intervention limits are missing. Candidate requires fracture at four manufactured notches and tang recovery.
comparison.reason: Both involve force interaction, but rotational fault recovery is meaningfully different from impact fracture and containment.
